assertions: The fixed official Node.js releases.xml endpoint returns RSS 2.0 without an account, credential, redirect or arbitrary URL input.
The reviewed Node.js feed identity, home URL, language and release-entry origin/path match the registered source.
A reviewed Node.js release entry is present with its official title, URL and publication time.
The Connector reads at most 512 KiB and 1,000 entries, returns at most 20 entries, declares partial coverage, and performs one GET without retry.
Author, email, content, description, enclosure, raw XML and unrecognized extension fields are excluded from the product output.
DTD declarations are rejected and XML is decoded as UTF-8 with a strict namespace-aware parser.
